library_name: Destiny Core Scout and Soldier Talents
notes: Detailed, paraphrased Core Rulebook talent reference.

rules.name: Expert Tracker
rules.description: Follow tracks at normal speed without the usual penalty.

mechanics.effect: Remove the normal -5 Survival penalty for following tracks while moving at your normal speed.

rules.name: Keen Shot
rules.description: Attack through ordinary concealment without an accuracy penalty.

mechanics.effect: Ignore the attack-roll penalty caused by concealment.
mechanics.special: Does not negate total concealment or allow targeting something you cannot locate.

rules.name: Uncanny Dodge I
rules.description: Retain Dexterity to Reflex while flat-footed or attacked from hiding.

mechanics.effect: Do not lose your Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense because you are flat-footed or struck by a hidden attacker.
mechanics.special: You still lose Dexterity to Reflex while immobilized. If you are a vehicle's pilot, the benefit applies to that vehicle.

rules.name: Uncanny Dodge II
rules.description: You cannot be flanked.

mechanics.effect: Opponents on opposite sides do not gain flanking benefits against you.
mechanics.special: If you are a vehicle's pilot, the benefit applies to that vehicle.

rules.name: Hidden Movement
rules.description: Move at normal speed without penalizing Stealth.

mechanics.effect: Take no Stealth penalty for moving at your normal speed.
mechanics.special: Also applies to Stealth checks while piloting a starship.

rules.name: Improved Stealth
rules.description: Reroll Stealth checks.

mechanics.effect: You may reroll it, but must accept the second result even if worse.
mechanics.special: Also applies to Stealth checks made while piloting a starship.

rules.name: Total Concealment
rules.description: Ordinary concealment becomes total concealment for you.

mechanics.effect: Treat that concealment as total concealment instead.

rules.name: Barter
rules.description: Reroll attempts to haggle.

mechanics.trigger: You make a Persuasion check to haggle.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the check, but must accept the second result.

rules.name: Fringe Savant
rules.description: A natural 20 on a skill check grants a temporary Force Point.

mechanics.trigger: During an encounter, roll a natural 20 on a skill check.
mechanics.effect: Gain 1 temporary Force Point.
mechanics.duration: Unused point disappears at encounter end.

rules.name: Jury-Rigger
rules.description: Reroll Mechanics checks made for jury-rigged repairs.

mechanics.trigger: You make a Mechanics check to jury-rig a repair.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll the check, but must accept the second result.

rules.name: Long Stride
rules.description: Increase ground and natural movement speeds while lightly armored.

mechanics.effect: Increase ground speed by 2 squares; also increase any natural fly, climb, or swim speed by 2.
mechanics.special: Functions only in light armor or no armor.

rules.name: Evasion
rules.description: Greatly reduce damage from area attacks.

mechanics.effect: Take half damage if the attack hits and no damage if it misses.
mechanics.special: If you are a vehicle's pilot, the benefit applies to that vehicle.

rules.name: Extreme Effort
rules.description: Spend time preparing for a powerful physical effort.

mechanics.effect: Gain +5 on one Strength check or Strength-based skill check made during the same round.

rules.name: Sprint
rules.description: Run five times your speed.

mechanics.effect: Move up to 5 × speed instead of the normal 4 × speed.

rules.name: Surefooted
rules.description: Move through difficult terrain without reduced speed.

mechanics.effect: Difficult terrain does not reduce your speed.
mechanics.special: Other terrain effects besides speed reduction still apply.

rules.name: Armor Mastery
rules.description: Increase the Dexterity bonus permitted by armor.

mechanics.effect: Increase the armor's maximum Dexterity bonus by 1.
mechanics.special: You must be proficient with the armor worn.

rules.name: Armored Defense
rules.description: Use the better of heroic level or armor bonus when calculating Reflex Defense.

mechanics.effect: When calculating Reflex Defense in armor, add either heroic level or armor bonus, whichever is higher.
mechanics.special: You must be proficient with the armor worn.

rules.name: Improved Armored Defense
rules.description: Combine heroic level with part of your armor bonus for Reflex Defense.

mechanics.effect: For Reflex Defense, use the better of: armor bonus; or heroic level + half armor bonus, rounded down.
mechanics.special: You must be proficient with the armor worn.

rules.name: Juggernaut
rules.description: Armor no longer slows ordinary movement or running.

mechanics.effect: Ignore armor-based reductions to speed and run distance.
mechanics.special: You must be proficient with the armor worn.

rules.name: Second Skin
rules.description: Increase both defensive bonuses supplied by proficient armor.

mechanics.effect: Increase the armor bonus to Reflex Defense and equipment bonus to Fortitude Defense by 1 each.
mechanics.special: You must be proficient with the armor worn.

rules.name: Expert Grappler
rules.description: Improve grapple attacks.

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 competence on grapple attacks.

rules.name: Gun Club
rules.description: Use a ranged weapon as a club without the improvised-weapon penalty.

mechanics.effect: Make melee attacks with a ranged weapon without the normal -5 improvised-weapon penalty; treat it as a club.
mechanics.special: A rifle with a bayonet may be wielded as a double weapon: bayonet normally, other end as a club.

rules.name: Melee Smash
rules.description: Deal additional damage with every melee attack.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 damage on melee attacks.

rules.name: Stunning Strike
rules.description: Threshold-breaking melee damage worsens the target's condition by an additional step.

mechanics.trigger: Your melee damage equals or exceeds the target's Damage Threshold.
mechanics.effect: Move the target one additional step down the condition track.

rules.name: Unbalance Opponent
rules.description: Deny one nearby-sized opponent its Strength bonus when it attacks you.

mechanics.use: Designate one opponent during your turn; may choose a new one on a later turn.
mechanics.target: An opponent no more than one size category larger or smaller than you.
mechanics.effect: The opponent cannot add a positive Strength modifier to attack rolls against you.
mechanics.special: A Strength penalty still applies, and Strength modifies damage normally.

rules.name: Battle Analysis
rules.description: Assess which visible combatants or detected vehicles have lost at least half their hit points.

mechanics.effect: Learn which allies and opponents in your line of sight are at half maximum hit points or fewer.
mechanics.special: For vehicles, also succeed on Use Computer DC 15.

rules.name: Demolitionist
rules.description: Placed explosives deal additional damage dice.

mechanics.trigger: Use Mechanics to place an explosive device.
mechanics.effect: Its explosion deals +2 damage dice per selection.
mechanics.special: Repeatable; the additional dice stack.

rules.name: Draw Fire
rules.description: Force affected enemies to target you instead of nearby allies.

mechanics.check: Persuasion vs. each visible opponent's Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: An affected opponent cannot attack another character within 6 squares of you, though it may attack you.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn while you do not have cover from that opponent.
mechanics.special: As vehicle pilot, can protect allied vehicles no more than one size larger than yours.

rules.name: Harm's Way
rules.description: Redirect attacks from an adjacent ally onto yourself.

mechanics.effect: Attacks against the ally target you instead, including damage and other effects.
mechanics.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
mechanics.special: You may decline protection against an individual attack before its roll. A pilot can similarly protect an allied vehicle no more than one size larger.

rules.name: Tough as Nails
rules.description: Gain another daily second wind.

mechanics.effect: Gain one additional second wind per day.
mechanics.special: With Extra Second Wind, the Core combination provides three daily uses; the once-per-encounter restriction remains.

rules.name: Penetrating Attack
rules.description: Reduce Damage Reduction against attacks with a selected weapon family.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.trigger: You hit using the selected exotic weapon or weapon group.
mechanics.effect: Treat the target's Damage Reduction as 5 lower for that attack.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different selections. Heavy Weapons selection applies to vehicle weapon attacks.
